item.title: Chelsea eyeing shock move for Lewis-Skelly
item.description: Chelsea have emerged as surprise contenders to sign Arsenal defender Myles Lewis-Skelly amid his limited playing time this campaign, according to Teamtalk.

item.title: Man Utd ready to sell Kobbie Mainoo in January?
item.description: Manchester United have reportedly opened the door to selling midfielder Kobbie Mainoo when the transfer window reopens in the New Year.

item.title: Chelsea want to sign more players like Estevao
item.description: Chelsea are reportedly keen on signing more young players like Estevao Willian in future transfer windows.

item.title: 'Quite good': Enzo Maresca sends message on Chelsea star

item.title: Man Utd absolutely want to sign Elliot Anderson

item.title: Confirmed Arsenal line-up vs Bayern Munich, Mosquera starts

item.title: Mikel Arteta drops big fitness update on Gabriel Jesus
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has dropped a big fitness update on Gabriel Jesus ahead of the Champions League clash against Bayern Munich at the Emirates Stadium.

item.title: Why Dutch Managers Struggle in the Premier League
item.description: The Premier League has welcomed several Dutch coaches over the years — Ruud Gullit, Martin Jol, Guus Hiddink, Louis van Gaal, and more recently Erik ten Hag. Last season, a Dutchman, Arne Slot, even won the league with Liverpool.
